I'm Vinícius, a Brazilian with international experience in customer service, IT support and leading Service Desk teams. I've worked in the Philippines, Portugal, Albania, Laos and Cambodia, and remotely (home office) for Armenia and Pakistan. I also have experience in graphic design and paid traffic.
Languages: Portuguese, English and Spanish (fluent), and Chinese with the help of AI tools. Choose a country below to see what I did in each place.
